mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, execution_phase = 'waiting_approval', active_millis = active_millis + IF(active_segment_started_at IS NULL, 0, GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, active_segment_started_at, #{now}) DIV 1000)), active_segment_started_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND id = #{id}

UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'queued', queued_at = #{now}, active_millis = active_millis + IF(active_segment_started_at IS NULL, 0, GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, active_segment_started_at, #{now}) DIV 1000)), active_segment_started_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND id = #{id}
